# AetherCloud

> AI-native, multi-cloud IoT fusion and control plane built with TypeScript.
> AetherCloud unifies provider capabilities, infrastructure plans, fleets,
> desired state, telemetry, and audited jobs while AetherEdge edge runtimes
> retain authority over live state and physical control.

Use this file as the primary documentation index. Read the narrowest page that
answers the task, then follow its links for deeper context.

## Start here

- [Product overview](docs/get-started/overview.md): Understand the multi-cloud product, its authority boundaries, and the first vertical slices
- [AetherIoT product family](docs/get-started/aetheriot-product-family.md): Place AetherCloud beside AetherEdge and AetherContracts without blurring edge, cloud, provider, or protocol authority
- [Build with an AI agent](docs/guides/build-with-an-agent.md): Use repository contracts and verification commands without inventing unsupported APIs
- [Add a Provider Adapter](docs/guides/add-provider-adapter.md): Implement provider discovery behind the application port and prove it with the shared conformance suite
- [Plan infrastructure safely](docs/guides/plan-infrastructure.md): Run the implemented OpenTofu Plan worker without implying Apply, production remote State, or safe plaintext output
- [AetherCloud Agent Skill](skills/aether-cloud/SKILL.md): Route implementation tasks to the right contracts, invariants, and safety checks

## Concepts

- [Architecture](docs/concepts/architecture.md): Understand the modular-monolith processes, dependency direction, and evolution rules
- [PostgreSQL persistence and multi-cloud cells](docs/concepts/persistence-and-multi-cloud-cells.md): Use the implemented Gateway and telemetry SQL slices without implying deployed production composition or global active-active writes
- [Audit, subscriptions, webhook delivery, and data export](docs/concepts/audit-and-integrations.md): Use the partial audit HTTP/SSE and integration workflow foundations without implying production durability, sending, or export retrieval
- [Current implementation audit](docs/concepts/current-state-audit.md): Distinguish executable layers, Broker evidence, and the PostgreSQL telemetry ACK slice from missing production surfaces
- [IoT Cloud capability map](docs/concepts/iot-cloud-capability-map.md): Audit implemented and planned IoT capabilities by bounded context, authority, storage, edge interaction, risk, and phase
- [IoT business telemetry](docs/concepts/iot-telemetry.md): Use replay-safe PostgreSQL acceptance, bounded history, and exact ACK delivery while public API, analytics, and production composition remain planned
- [Artifact registry and immutable publication](docs/concepts/artifact-registry.md): Use the partial signed content-addressed publication foundation without implying deployment or edge application
- [Desired, Reported, and Applied deployment](docs/concepts/desired-reported-applied-deployment.md): Use the partial single-target rollout foundation without treating dispatch, timeout, or connection as Applied evidence
- [Governed capability Jobs](docs/concepts/governed-capability-jobs.md): Use the partial capability-gated Job and ordered Receipt foundation without implying arbitrary RPC or remote execution
- [Operational observability](docs/concepts/operational-observability.md): Use the optional OpenTelemetry adapter foundation without replacing IoT telemetry or durable audit
- [MCP application interface](docs/concepts/mcp-application-interface.md): Use the implemented transport-neutral resources/tools while treating the MCP wire server, production identity, and persistence as planned
- [Gateway identity and enrollment](docs/concepts/gateway-identity-and-enrollment.md): Use the implemented registration and claim foundation without implying production certificates or HTTP routes
- [CloudLink and core state machines](docs/concepts/cloudlink-and-core-state-machines.md): Use the partial session, heartbeat, Runtime Manifest, and experimental MQTT ingress while production process and durable delivery remain planned
- [Multi-cloud fusion](docs/concepts/multi-cloud-fusion.md): Unify cloud lifecycle and policy without erasing provider capabilities or sharing one global state
- [Edge, AetherCloud, and provider authority](docs/concepts/edge-cloud-boundary.md): Assign live, desired, and actual state across edge runtimes, AetherCloud, and infrastructure providers
- [Resource model](docs/concepts/resource-model.md): Use cloud connection, deployment stack, fleet, and edge resource vocabulary consistently
- [AI invariants](ai/invariants.md): Preserve authority, tenancy, command safety, and documentation truth across refactors

- [HTTP API](docs/reference/http-api.md): Call the implemented HTTP endpoints and distinguish them from planned versioned APIs

- [Pre-release CloudLink MQTT v1](docs/reference/cloudlink-mqtt-v1.md): Review local/AWS Broker evidence and the PostgreSQL telemetry ACK slice while preserving unresolved authentication and full durability gates
- [Repository layout](docs/reference/repository-layout.md): Place code in the correct application, domain, adapter, or composition-root package
- [Terminology](docs/reference/terminology.md): Resolve AetherCloud terms before naming contracts or database records
- [IoT Cloud vertical-slice roadmap](docs/guides/iot-cloud-roadmap.md): Deliver independently testable Gateway, CloudLink, telemetry, artifact, deployment, Job, operations, and MCP slices

## Decisions

- [ADR-0001: Edge-first cloud control plane](docs/adr/0001-edge-first-cloud-control-plane.md): Keep the cloud optional for deterministic edge operation
- [ADR-0002: TypeScript modular monolith](docs/adr/0002-typescript-modular-monolith.md): Start with one workspace and independently scalable composition roots
- [ADR-0003: Agent-ready documentation](docs/adr/0003-agent-ready-documentation.md): Treat LLM-readable documentation as a tested product interface
- [ADR-0004: Capability-driven multi-cloud fusion](docs/adr/0004-multi-cloud-fusion.md): Use OpenTofu by default, preserve provider modules, and isolate infrastructure state by deployment stack
- [ADR-0005: Gateway identity and enrollment](docs/adr/0005-gateway-identity-and-enrollment.md): Separate registration, bootstrap claims, credential binding, revocation, and recovery
- [ADR-0006: CloudLink sessions and durable delivery](docs/adr/0006-cloudlink-durable-delivery.md): Fence sessions and deliver exact telemetry ACKs only after durable acceptance
- [ADR-0007: Durable IoT telemetry ingestion](docs/adr/0007-durable-iot-telemetry.md): Accept replayed batches atomically in PostgreSQL and recover the identical durable ACK
- [ADR-0008: OpenTelemetry operational observability](docs/adr/0008-operational-observability.md): Keep traces and metrics outside IoT data authority and audit
- [ADR-0009: Immutable artifact publication](docs/adr/0009-immutable-artifact-publication.md): Keep immutable revision content separate from channels, deployment intent, and edge application evidence
- [ADR-0010: Desired, Reported, and Applied deployment](docs/adr/0010-desired-reported-applied-deployment.md): Preserve cloud intent, edge observation, applied evidence, and unknown as separate facts
- [ADR-0011: Governed capability Jobs and Receipts](docs/adr/0011-governed-capability-jobs.md): Deny undeclared capabilities and preserve uncertainty, cancellation intent, ordered Receipts, and edge outcomes
- [ADR-0012: Durable audit and outbound integrations](docs/adr/0012-durable-audit-and-outbound-integrations.md): Separate committed outcomes from audit streams, outbound attempts, dead letters, and immutable exports
- [ADR-0013: PostgreSQL control-plane persistence and multi-cloud cells](docs/adr/0013-postgresql-control-plane-persistence.md): Use PostgreSQL Gateway and telemetry slices as portable cell authority while keeping analytics, provider profiles, and failover explicit
- [ADR-0014: Experimental CloudLink MQTT transport binding](docs/adr/0014-cloudlink-mqtt-transport-binding.md): Use an operator-selected broker without trusting MQTT topic identity or weakening application acknowledgements
- [ADR-0015: CloudLink interoperability release gates](docs/adr/0015-cloudlink-interoperability-release-gates.md): Record alpha.3 Broker and telemetry ACK evidence while keeping full authentication, durability, and legacy cutover gated
- [ADR-0016: Pinned AetherContracts consumption](docs/adr/0016-pinned-aethercontracts-consumption.md): Consume one exact public release offline while separating distribution integrity from codec and interoperability conformance
- [ADR-0017: Adopt AetherIoT product-family naming](docs/adr/0017-aetheriot-product-family-naming.md): Name the edge product AetherEdge while preserving AetherCloud authority, stable software identifiers, and immutable contract evidence
